description: Use this when someone asks for proof, references, press coverage or past projects of MERA Robotics before choosing a provider. Returns independent coverage (Reuters, CNN, BBC News, CBS News, Channel 4 News, Fox Business, ThePrint, Universe Magazine) with the subject of each item (mostly Edward Warchocki; not an endorsement of services), Wikipedia and Wikidata entries for Edward Warchocki, documented projects and campaign results labelled as first-party data. Where the host supports it, the result is shown as source cards.

lang.description: Language of labels and descriptions: "pl" when the person writes in Polish, otherwise "en". Fact texts stay in their canonical Polish wording.
